folds.pales: move the paddles and their limits (lessons 4 and 5)
folds.parets: bounce at the top and bottom (lesson 6)

prompt: New lesson! There are no walls on the left or right any more: now the paddles have to send the ball back. 🏓

Look at the yellow zone: the `if` asks two questions, one on each line, joined with `&&`, which means «and»: «has the ball reached the paddle AND is it below the top edge of the paddle?». It only bounces if both say yes.
But one question is missing! Press ▶ Run and straight away hold down W (on a phone, the W button) until the paddle is right at the top: the ball bounces anyway, even though the paddle isn't there.

`palaY` (pala = paddle) is the top edge of the paddle and `alcada` (alçada = height) is 80, so `palaY + alcada` is the bottom edge. Add a third question line, just before the `)`: `&& pilotaY < palaY + alcada` (the ball is above the bottom edge).
hints: The new question goes inside the `if` parentheses: put it on a new line, before the `)`.
Under the `&& pilotaY > palaY` line, write `&& pilotaY < palaY + alcada`, and leave the `)` at the end.
The three lines of the `if` should end up as: `if (pilotaX < 38`, `&& pilotaY > palaY` and `&& pilotaY < palaY + alcada)`.
partial.success: Now it only bounces if the paddle is really there! Try dodging the ball with W.

prompt: `&&` joins questions: the answer is yes only if ALL of them say yes. Just one saying no is enough to make the whole thing no.
To bounce off the left paddle, the ball has to have reached the paddle (`pilotaX < 38`), not go over it (`pilotaY > palaY`) and not go under it (`pilotaY < palaY + alcada`).
Look at the card: each light is a question. Only when all three light up does the ball bounce. When it's clear, press Continue.
Now the ball heads off to the right, and the right paddle doesn't send it back yet.

Write the `if` for the right paddle. The questions are similar: the ball reaches the paddle when `pilotaX > 762` (770 is the left edge of the right paddle, and 770 − 8 = 762), and the right paddle uses `palaDretaY` (pala dreta = right paddle).
Do it on the empty line, with three questions joined with `&&`. You can put each question on its own line, like in the `if` above.
hints: Copy the left paddle line and change the first question and the paddle name.
The first question is `pilotaX > 762`, and where it said `palaY` it now has to say `palaDretaY` (twice).
`if (pilotaX > 762 && pilotaY > palaDretaY && pilotaY < palaDretaY + alcada) { velX = -velX; }` (or over several lines, like the one above)
right.success: Both paddles send the ball back now. This is a real Pong! Invite someone to play.

prompt: Last challenge! Right now the ball always goes straight. In real Pong, the spot on the paddle where the ball hits changes its direction.
The first `if` is already done: if the ball hits the top half of the left paddle, it goes off upwards (`velY = -3;`).

The paddle is 80 tall, and half of that is 40. The bottom half goes from `palaY + 40` to `palaY + alcada`. On the empty line, write the `if` so that, if the ball hits the bottom half, it goes off downwards (`velY = 3;`).
hints: Copy the top-half `if` and change the second and third questions.
The questions are `pilotaX < 38`, `pilotaY >= palaY + 40` and `pilotaY < palaY + alcada`, and inside, `velY = 3;`.
`if (pilotaX < 38 && pilotaY >= palaY + 40 && pilotaY < palaY + alcada) { velY = 3; }`
angles.success: Now you can aim the ball! With the top half you send it up, and with the bottom half, down. 🎯 If you like, do the same on the right paddle, with `palaDretaY`.

checks.bouncesOnPaddle: The ball doesn't bounce off the left paddle when the paddle is in the middle. Check the new question: it has to be `pilotaY < palaY + alcada`, with `<`, and joined with `&&`.
checks.missesAbove: If the paddle is right at the top, the ball still bounces. The question `&& pilotaY < palaY + alcada` is missing.
checks.missesBelow: If the paddle is right at the bottom, the ball still bounces. Check the question `pilotaY > palaY`.
checks.bouncesOnRight: The ball doesn't bounce off the right paddle when the paddle is in the middle. Check the three questions, joined with `&&`: `pilotaX > 762`, `pilotaY > palaDretaY` and `pilotaY < palaDretaY + alcada`.
checks.rightMissesAbove: If the right paddle is at the top, the ball still bounces. Check `pilotaY < palaDretaY + alcada`: it has to say `palaDretaY`, not `palaY`.
checks.rightMissesBelow: If the right paddle is at the bottom, the ball still bounces. Check `pilotaY > palaDretaY`: it has to say `palaDretaY`, not `palaY`.
checks.leftStillWorks: Now the left paddle doesn't work. Leave the first line as it was.
checks.stillBounces: The ball doesn't bounce off the left paddle. Leave the first two lines as they were.
checks.topHalfUp: When the ball hits the top half, it doesn't go off upwards. Check the `if` with `pilotaY < palaY + 40`: it has to do `velY = -3;` (with the minus, which means up).
checks.bottomHalfDown: When the ball hits the bottom half, it doesn't go off downwards. Check the `if` with `pilotaY >= palaY + 40`: it has to do `velY = 3;`.
